# DropSpace v0.3.0-preview.20 — Architecture remediation

<!-- update-summary: Preview.20 closes the Preview.19 architecture audit with a transactional payload-delete outbox, crash-persistent confined staging including virtual OLE, reparse-safe bounded DropLink, bounded remote metadata/cache, explicit app use cases, SPKI/thumbprint update trust, 1000-cycle overlay plateau checks, secret scanning, least-privilege release gates, deterministic branding, and verified unsigned Preview artifacts. -->

Preview.20 is the architecture-remediation follow-up to the published Preview.19 baseline. It keeps the Windows 10 version 1809 / Build 17763 and later x64 boundary, Dynamic Island product boundary, local-first storage, external-source reference-only rule, existing Smart Drag/OLE and Clipboard contracts, and Stable/Preview update semantics.

## Shipped hardening

- Destructive removal records app-owned payload-delete obligations transactionally; startup reconciliation and the bounded janitor drain them idempotently.
- Internet Share, DropLink receive, staged import, and virtual OLE materialization use atomic, confined, crash-persistent staging leases with restart recovery.
- DropLink enumeration is asynchronous, bounded, cancellation-aware, and reparse-safe; remote metadata admission and availability caching are bounded.
- Device handoff, sharing, and workspace mutation use explicit app-facing use cases. Update trust requires an approved certificate-chain identity with SPKI/thumbprint rollover support.
- Overlay motion applies per-frame values to stable compositor visuals and reuses a single dispatcher timer per active session. Hosted Windows smoke records 100/250/500/750/1000-cycle resource samples and requires a plateau.
- CI/release gates pin actions, enforce least privilege, scan secrets, validate deterministic brand assets, and validate the intentional unsigned Preview MSIX policy.

## Automated verification

The publication candidate is required to pass Core, Infrastructure, App, Worker, localization, compatibility, release-contract, portable en-US/zh-CN smoke, installer lifecycle, release-bundle, website deployment, and secret-scan gates. The Windows smoke evidence includes startup visibility, clipboard integration, OLE/CF_HDROP compact and expanded paths, projection deletion stress, native-region geometry, and the 1000-cycle resource plateau.

## Conditional target verification

The following remain conditional until directly exercised on their target environments: Windows 10 1809, Windows 10 22H2, Windows 11, mixed-DPI and multi-monitor hotplug/sleep/RDP, Explorer/SMB/OneDrive/virtual providers, physical OLE/cursor/accessibility behavior, two-device LAN transfer and clipboard, a deployed Worker/browser, real disk-full/permission/SMB-stall recovery, and true long-run performance.

The release publishes the five validated Preview assets: \`DropSpace-x64.msix\`, \`DropSpace.exe\`, \`DropSpaceSetup.exe\`, \`SHA256SUMS.txt\`, and \`update-manifest.json\`. Publication must verify that Preview.19's tag, release, assets, and history remain unchanged.
